{{Quote|You're looking for a Corellian man named Zoda Burb. His application says he's "a small businessman engaged in a variety of projects.|[[Brantlee Spondoon]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BS" />}}
'''Zoda Burb''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] businessman and [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:BS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Zoda Burb encountered the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Midgoss D'labaninaph]] who had just arrived on Corellia. The con artist swindled the Devaronian and abandoned him in the wilderness without any money. D'labaninaph therefore tried to win the favor of [[Brantlee Spondoon]], the greedy assistant to the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Diktat]] [[Daclif Gallamby]], with a gift in order to have Zoda Burb punished. The attempt of the Devaronian was unfruitful but ironically inspired Burb who was more successful. The con artist offered a container of [[Neonan red cheese]] that extremely delighted Spondoon. The woman thus included the "businessman" in the government's contacts for future reference.<ref name="SWG:BS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zoda Burb was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
